flows:
Navigate to https://www.first.org/ then Use only keyboard input.
Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control.
Move in whichever direction is shorter.
Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently.
Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination.
Complete the registered journey in order and check each requested outcome.
For keyboard operation, use the declared arrow keys and Escape as needed.
Do not use a substitute destination or control.
If a required control or outcome is inaccessible, @v16:"report the exact step that failed".
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open “About FIRST” from keyboard focus or with Arrow Down and follow “Mission Statement”.
Confirm the public destination /about/mission.

summary:
The agent used the focused About FIRST control as a page link. The journey specifically required opening that menu with keyboard navigation, then following Mission Statement. Because the wrong keyboard action was used, the run went to /about and could not continue when that request failed.
Update the keyboard flow to press Arrow Down on About FIRST, move focus to Mission Statement, and activate it. Treat a failure loading the unintended /about route as incidental unless it is independently reproduced.
one_liner: The run activated the About FIRST link and navigated to /about instead of opening its menu and choosing Mission Statement.

Because the wrong keyboard action was used, the run went to /about and could not continue when that request failed.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the terminal outcome by activating the focused top-level About FIRST control rather than using Arrow Down to open its submenu and selecting Mission Statement. The failed /about request occurred only after that incorrect route was chosen, so it does not establish that the required Mission Statement journey or the product destination was broken.
